title: Phi Phi Islands Speedboat Tour from Phuket
description: Visit Maya Bay, Pileh Lagoon, and Monkey Beach on a full-day speedboat tour with lunch, snorkeling gear, and hotel transfers included.

title: James Bond Island & Phang Nga Bay by Longtail Boat
description: Cruise through Phang Nga Bay's dramatic limestone karsts, visit James Bond Island, and canoe through sea caves with a local guide.

title: Similan Islands Full-Day Snorkeling Trip
description: Travel to the crystal-clear waters of the Similan Islands for a full day of snorkeling across three world-class sites with lunch on the beach.

title: Phuket Sunset Cruise with Dinner & Live Music
description: Sail along Phuket's west coast as the sun sets, enjoying a Thai-Western buffet dinner and live acoustic music aboard a traditional junk boat.

title: Khai Islands Speedboat Half-Day Tour
description: Spend a relaxed half day on the three Khai Islands with time for swimming, snorkeling, and sunbathing on powdery white-sand beaches.

title: Coral Island (Koh He) Day Trip with Parasailing Option
description: Take a short boat ride to Coral Island for a beach day with optional parasailing, banana boat rides, and a beachside Thai lunch.

title: Phuket 3-Dive Day Trip for Certified Divers
description: Explore three dive sites around Racha Yai and Racha Noi islands with full equipment, divemaster, and lunch aboard a comfortable dive boat.

title: Discover Scuba Diving Experience for Beginners
description: Try scuba diving for the first time with a certified instructor at a shallow coral reef near Phuket, no experience required.

title: Half-Day Snorkeling Tour to Racha Island
description: Snorkel among tropical fish and coral reefs at Racha Yai Island with all equipment provided and a light lunch on the boat.

title: Snorkeling at Maiton & Coral Island by Catamaran
description: Cruise to two pristine snorkeling spots aboard a catamaran with buffet lunch, fruit platters, and an open bar on the return journey.

title: Morning Thai Cooking Class with Market Tour
description: Shop for ingredients at a local market, then cook five authentic Thai dishes in an open-air kitchen with a professional chef.

title: Evening Thai Cooking Experience in Kata
description: Learn to prepare four classic Thai dishes in a garden setting with a sunset cocktail and enjoy your creations for dinner.

title: Farm-to-Table Cooking Class in Bang Tao
description: Pick herbs from an organic garden, learn to make curry paste from scratch, and cook a full Thai meal at a boutique farm near Bang Tao.

title: Phuket Family Cooking Class for Kids & Parents
description: A hands-on cooking session designed for families where kids make pad thai and mango sticky rice alongside their parents.

title: Big Buddha, Wat Chalong & Old Town Temple Tour
description: Visit Phuket's three most important temples in one morning with a knowledgeable English-speaking guide and hotel pickup.

title: Phuket Old Town Walking Tour & Street Art Trail
description: Stroll through Sino-Portuguese shophouses, discover hidden street art, visit a local shrine, and taste traditional Phuket snacks.

title: Wat Chalong & Big Buddha Sunset Visit with Guide
description: Beat the crowds with a late-afternoon temple tour that finishes at Big Buddha for panoramic sunset views over Chalong Bay.

title: Old Town Heritage & Peranakan Culture Half-Day Tour
description: Explore Phuket's Peranakan heritage through museum visits, a traditional shophouse tour, and a Hokkien noodle lunch in Old Town.

title: Phuket ATV Adventure through Jungle Trails
description: Ride an ATV through muddy jungle tracks, rubber plantations, and hilltop viewpoints on this adrenaline-pumping guided excursion.

title: Flying Hanuman Zipline Adventure in Phuket Rainforest
description: Soar through the jungle canopy on 28 zipline platforms with sky bridges and abseil descents in Phuket's premier treetop adventure park.

title: Surf Lesson at Kata Beach for Beginners
description: Learn to surf with a certified instructor at Kata Beach, one of Phuket's best beginner-friendly surf spots, board and rashguard included.

title: Muay Thai Training Session with Pro Fighters
description: Train at an authentic Muay Thai gym with professional fighters, covering basic techniques, pad work, and conditioning in a 90-minute session.

title: Phuket Elephant Sanctuary Half-Day Visit
description: Spend a morning at an ethical elephant sanctuary where you walk with, feed, and bathe retired working elephants in a natural forest setting.

title: Phuket Elephant Jungle Walk & Waterfall Trip
description: Walk alongside elephants on a jungle trail to a hidden waterfall, followed by an organic Thai lunch at the sanctuary camp.

title: Gibbon Rehabilitation Centre & Rainforest Hike
description: Visit a gibbon conservation project in Khao Phra Thaeo National Park and hike through old-growth rainforest with a naturalist guide.

title: Sea Kayaking through Phang Nga Bay Sea Caves
description: Paddle through dramatic limestone caves and hidden lagoons in Phang Nga Bay on a guided full-day sea kayaking adventure.

title: Jet Ski Tour around Phuket's Southern Islands
description: Ride a jet ski on a guided island-hopping route past Koh Lon and Coral Island with a break for swimming and photos.

title: Parasailing over Patong Beach
description: Fly 150 meters above Patong Beach for panoramic views of the Andaman coast on a safe tandem parasailing flight with boat crew.

title: Stand-Up Paddleboard Lesson & Mangrove Tour
description: Learn to SUP in calm waters, then paddle through a scenic mangrove forest with a guide who shares local ecology knowledge.

title: Traditional Thai Massage & Herbal Spa (2 Hours)
description: Unwind with a two-hour traditional Thai massage followed by an aromatic herbal compress treatment at a peaceful hillside spa.

title: Luxury Spa & Hot Spring Day Retreat
description: Spend a full day at a luxury spa with access to natural hot springs, a mineral pool, aromatherapy massage, and a healthy Thai lunch.

title: Beachside Yoga & Meditation Sunrise Session
description: Start the day with a guided yoga and meditation session on the beach at sunrise, suitable for all levels including complete beginners.

title: Phuket Street Food Tour by Tuk-Tuk
description: Hop between eight iconic street food stalls by tuk-tuk, tasting Hokkien noodles, roti, dim sum, and Phuket-style curries with a local guide.

title: Patong Night Market & Thai Food Tasting Tour
description: Explore Patong's vibrant night market with a guide who introduces you to local Thai dishes, fresh seafood, and tropical desserts.

title: Phuket Weekend Market & Local Eats Walking Tour
description: Browse Naka Weekend Market with a foodie guide, sampling over 10 dishes from grilled seafood to coconut ice cream.

title: Phuket Instagram Tour: Viewpoints & Hidden Gems
description: Hit the island's most photogenic spots from Promthep Cape to Windmill Viewpoint in an air-conditioned van with a photographer guide.

title: Phuket City & Highlights Half-Day Sightseeing Tour
description: Cover Phuket's top sights including Karon Viewpoint, a cashew nut factory, and Old Town in a comfortable half-day group tour.

title: Cape Panwa Aquarium & Panoramic Viewpoint Tour
description: Visit the Phuket Aquarium at Cape Panwa, followed by a scenic drive to Khao Khad Viewpoint for 360-degree island views.

title: Simon Cabaret Show Phuket (Regular Seat)
description: Watch Phuket's famous cabaret show featuring dazzling costumes, choreography, and live performances in a grand theater in Patong.

title: Bangla Road Night Tour & Muay Thai Fight
description: Experience Patong's famous Bangla Road nightlife scene followed by ringside seats at a live Muay Thai boxing match.

title: Phuket FantaSea Cultural Theme Show & Dinner
description: Enjoy a grand theatrical show celebrating Thai mythology and culture, preceded by a lavish buffet dinner at the FantaSea complex.

title: Private Airport Transfer from Phuket Airport
description: Reliable private car transfer from Phuket International Airport to any hotel on the island with meet-and-greet and luggage assistance.

title: Phuket Half-Day Private Car Charter with Driver
description: Hire a private car with an English-speaking driver for half a day to explore Phuket at your own pace, itinerary fully flexible.

title: Luxury Private Yacht Sunset Cruise with Chef
description: Charter a private yacht along the Andaman coast with a personal chef preparing a five-course dinner as you watch the sunset.

title: Wakeboarding at Phuket Wake Park
description: Try cable wakeboarding at Phuket's dedicated wake park with beginner instruction, equipment, and two hours of ride time included.

title: Phuket Rainy Day Indoor Activities Pass
description: All-day pass covering Phuket's top indoor attractions including Trick Eye Museum, VR arcade, and indoor go-karts.

title: Phuket Escape Room & Board Game Cafe Experience
description: Tackle a themed escape room challenge followed by unlimited play at a board game cafe with drinks, ideal for rainy afternoons.

title: Baby & Toddler Splash Park Half-Day Entry
description: Supervised water play area with shallow pools, mini slides, and splash zones designed specifically for children aged 0-5.

title: Wat Chalong Temple Visit & Meditation Workshop
description: Tour Phuket's most revered temple with a monk-led introduction to Buddhist meditation, suitable for all backgrounds and fitness levels.

title: Phuket Batik Painting & Tie-Dye Workshop
description: Create your own batik fabric art and tie-dye T-shirt in a hands-on workshop led by a local artisan, great for all ages and rainy days.
